about: The Daily Thread Fashion Dictionary (reviewed terms; candidates awaiting review are in dictionary_proposed.json): canonical fashion terms with stable ids, aliases, definitions and a category tree. google_taxonomy on a category is its Google Product Taxonomy id (2021-09-21 version). Edit by hand; tests/test_dictionary.py validates it. 'query' is the Google Trends search phrase and the snapshot key. Definitions are written for this project and not yet editorially reviewed (verified: false).

sources.note: Definition written for The Daily Thread

terms.name: Barrel jeans
terms.definition: Jeans that curve outward through the thigh and knee and narrow again at the ankle, giving a rounded, barrel-like leg.

terms.name: Baggy jeans
terms.definition: Loose jeans cut wide from hip to hem, often worn low on the waist.

terms.name: Wide-leg jeans
terms.definition: Jeans that fall straight and wide from the hip to the hem.

terms.name: Flare jeans
terms.definition: Jeans fitted through the thigh that widen from the knee down.
terms.notes: Bootcut jeans flare less and are a separate style.

terms.name: Skinny jeans
terms.definition: Tight jeans that follow the leg all the way to the ankle.

terms.name: Mom jeans
terms.definition: High-waisted, relaxed jeans that taper toward the ankle, a style associated with the late 1980s and 1990s.

terms.name: Ballet flats
terms.definition: Flat, slip-on shoes modelled on ballet slippers, usually with a rounded toe.

terms.name: Mary Jane shoes
terms.definition: Shoes with a strap across the instep, usually with a rounded toe.

terms.name: Penny loafers
terms.definition: Slip-on leather shoes with a strap across the top that has a small slot.
terms.notes: 'Loafers' alone covers more styles, so it is not an alias. The Wikipedia signal uses the general Loafer article.

terms.name: Adidas Samba
terms.definition: A low-profile Adidas trainer, first made as an indoor football shoe, with a gum sole and a suede T-shaped toe overlay.
terms.notes: A single brand's product, not a generic style.

terms.name: Chunky sneakers
terms.definition: Trainers with a thick, oversized sole.

terms.name: Cowboy boots
terms.definition: Heeled boots with a pointed or squared toe and decorative stitching, from western riding wear.

terms.name: Knee-high boots
terms.definition: Boots whose shaft reaches up to the knee.

terms.name: Quiet luxury
terms.definition: Understated, logo-free clothing in high-quality materials and neutral colours.

terms.name: Old money aesthetic
terms.definition: A look borrowing from traditional upper-class dress: tailoring, knitwear, loafers and neutral colours.

terms.name: Coquette aesthetic
terms.definition: A romantic, girlish look built around bows, lace, pastels and ruffles.

terms.name: Mob wife aesthetic
terms.definition: A glamorous look of fur coats, animal print, gold jewellery and dark lipstick, popularised on social media in early 2024.

terms.name: Clean girl aesthetic
terms.definition: A minimal, polished look: slicked-back hair, light make-up, simple gold jewellery and neutral basics.

terms.name: Y2K fashion
terms.definition: Styles revived from the late 1990s and early 2000s, such as low-rise trousers, baby tees and tinted sunglasses.

terms.name: Cottagecore
terms.definition: A romantic rural look: floral prints, puff sleeves, prairie dresses and handmade details.

terms.name: Gorpcore
terms.definition: Outdoor and hiking gear worn as everyday fashion: fleece, technical shells and trail shoes.

terms.name: Boho chic
terms.definition: Bohemian-influenced dressing: flowing fabrics, fringe, embroidery and layered jewellery.

terms.name: Office siren
terms.definition: A sharp, sensual take on office wear: slim tailoring, pencil skirts, fitted shirts and slim glasses.

terms.name: Leopard print
terms.definition: A spotted pattern imitating leopard fur.
terms.notes: 'Animal print' is broader (zebra, snake), so it is not an alias.

terms.name: Polka dot dress
terms.definition: A dress patterned with evenly spaced round dots.

terms.name: Suede jacket
terms.definition: A jacket made of suede, leather with a soft napped finish.

terms.name: Barn jacket
terms.definition: A hip-length cotton canvas jacket with a corduroy collar, first made as farm and country workwear.

terms.name: Bomber jacket
terms.definition: A short jacket gathered at the waist and cuffs, derived from military flight jackets.

terms.name: Trench coat
terms.definition: A belted, usually double-breasted raincoat in water-resistant fabric, classically khaki.

terms.name: Cargo pants
terms.definition: Loose trousers with large patch pockets on the legs.

terms.name: Capri pants
terms.definition: Close-fitting trousers that end between the knee and the ankle.

terms.name: Maxi skirt
terms.definition: A skirt that reaches the ankle or the floor.

terms.name: Bubble skirt
terms.definition: A skirt whose hem is gathered and tucked under to make a rounded, puffed shape.

terms.name: Sheer dress
terms.definition: A dress made of transparent or semi-transparent fabric.

terms.name: Crochet top
terms.definition: A top made from crocheted yarn, often with open, lacy stitches.

terms.name: Faux fur coat
terms.definition: A coat made of synthetic fibres that imitate animal fur.
